query: INSERT INTO latest_valetudo_state (identifier, state, battery_level, fan_speed) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4) ON CONFLICT (identifier) DO UPDATE SET state = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.state, latest_valetudo_state.state), battery_level = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.battery_level, latest_valetudo_state.battery_level), fan_speed = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.fan_speed, latest_valetudo_state.fan_speed), updated_at = now()
